finding.text: ext/Chat/Mic.js:67 (`same_as_last_send`) drops a real follow-up message. `strip_words(prev, t) === ""` is true whenever the earlier message matches the START of the new one. So "Okay." followed within 4 s by "Okay, now delete the branch." scores 0 on the first word and the whole second message is thrown away. The reverse test also drops a shorter repeat ("Yes, do it." then "Yes."). Natural-pause sending splits speech into sentences that often start alike, so this will happen. The duplicate check should compare the WHOLE of both texts: `D[S.length][T.length] / max(len)` ≤ 0.35, instead of reusing the prefix-strip.

The brief should be committed beside the task.

ext/drawer/rail.js:342 changes the phone sheet's visible title from "Ask, by voice" to `this.constructor.name`, which shows the raw class name "DrawerRailSheetChat" to the owner.
